ardf.df-desc: Enter the coordinates of a few bearings and the azimuth each one points to (0° = north, clockwise), with an angular error. Leave a whole row empty to skip it; an empty error counts as 2°.
ardf.df-need-more: At least two bearings are needed to cross-fix a position.
ardf.df-bad-input: A coordinate or angle is missing or out of range: latitude -90 to 90, longitude -180 to 180, error 0–45°.
ardf.df-parallel: These bearings are nearly parallel (or opposite), so there is no unique crossing. Take one from a clearly different position.
ardf.df-ellipse: 95% error ellipse: {} m × {} m, major axis at {}°

ardf.df-behind.one: The crossing lies behind the station of {} bearing. Check that bearing's azimuth (it may be off by 180°).
ardf.df-behind.other: The crossing lies behind the stations of {} bearings. Check their azimuths (they may be off by 180°).

ardf.df-wide: The error ellipse is huge, which means the bearings cross at too shallow an angle. Take one from another position instead of trusting this point.
